# CogniStream Beta Program

Thanks for helping us ship the payment rails AI agents will actually use.

## How to join

1. **Open a GitHub issue** using the [Beta feedback](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/beta_feedback.yml) template and select **Join beta**, **or**
2. **Email** [beta@cognistream.io](mailto:beta@cognistream.io) with:
   - Your GitHub handle
   - Company / project
   - Primary use case (agent marketplace, tool payments, escrow, etc.)

We typically respond within 2 business days.

## What beta users get

| Perk | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Developer tier free** | 3 months of Developer plan ($99/mo value) |
| **Community access** | Private Discord/Slack channel with the core team |
| **Direct feedback lane** | Priority responses on bugs and feature requests |
| **Early features** | Webhooks v2, Python SDK previews, higher rate limits |

## What we need from you

- Real usage of the TypeScript SDK and/or REST API
- Bug reports with request IDs when possible
- Honest feedback on DX (docs, errors, dashboard)
- Feature requests grounded in your agent workflows
